package course

import (
	"context"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// CreateCourseInput holds input values.
type CreateCourseInput struct {
	ID               string
	Slug             string
	SourceKey        string
	MainTechID       int
	CatalogVisible   *bool
	LessonReadAccess *domain.LessonReadAccess
}

// CreateCourse creates a draft course without versions.
type CreateCourse struct {
	Courses   repository.CourseRepository
	Publisher domain.EventPublisher
	Tx        repository.TransactionManager
}

// Handle performs creation and emits events.
func (uc CreateCourse) Handle(ctx context.Context, in CreateCourseInput) (domain.Course, error) {
	var course domain.Course

	run := func(fn func(ctx context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}

	if err := run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		courseID := strings.TrimSpace(in.ID)
		if courseID == "" {
			courseID = uuid.NewString()
		} else if _, err := uuid.Parse(courseID); err != nil {
			return domain.ErrValidation
		}
		sourceKey, err := domain.NormalizeContentSourceKey(in.SourceKey)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		course = domain.Course{
			ID:               courseID,
			Slug:             in.Slug,
			SourceKey:        sourceKey,
			CreatedAt:        time.Now().UTC(),
			UpdatedAt:        time.Now().UTC(),
			Status:           domain.CourseStatusDraft,
			CatalogVisible:   false,
			LessonReadAccess: in.LessonReadAccess,
		}
		if err := domain.ValidateLessonReadAccess(in.LessonReadAccess); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if in.CatalogVisible != nil {
			course.CatalogVisible = *in.CatalogVisible
		}
		if in.MainTechID > 0 {
			techID := in.MainTechID
			course.MainTechID = &techID
		}
		return uc.Courses.Create(ctx, course)
	}); err != nil {
		return domain.Course{}, err
	}

	_ = uc.Publisher.Publish(ctx, domain.SubjectCourseCreated, map[string]any{
		"course_id": course.ID,
		"slug":      course.Slug,
	})

	return course, nil
}
